versions.changelog:
- Updated acceptance documentation in ACCEPTANCE.md.
- Minor corrections to skill metadata in skill.json.
- No changes to user-facing features or functionality.

- Initial release of the Appliance Service Visit Prep Sheet skill.
- Helps users prepare a comprehensive, technician-ready handoff for appliance service visits with model/serial info, symptom timeline, and visit details.
- Includes checklist for safe photos, access notes, technician questions, and visit-day documentation fields.
- Focuses on communication, documentation, and visit success—does not provide repair instructions or diagnose faults.
- Strong safety boundaries: does not guide internal repairs, emergency troubleshooting, or instruct unsafe actions.
- Designed for use when a technician appointment is scheduled or detailed prep is needed for appliance service.
